I answered Tobias in a thread on their message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the ticket is **#8841**.

- **Where it came from:** Tobias posted it themselves in #central-random on Oct 13 at 09:27. West yard Door 2 at the Plains depots was still double-booking when flatbeds checked in early at the kiosk, and they flagged it to support on #8841. Tobias is a member of #central-random, so this is something they could see themselves.
- **One assumption:** that message calls it "Tobias's dealer account," not Marrow Fieldworks. I took them to be the same because a January handoff note lists Marrow Fieldworks as the Central team's dealer account changing hands on 5 Jan 2026.
- **Not double-checked:** I couldn't open any account ticket files (the folder showed nothing to me), so that message is my only source. I told Tobias this in the reply.

Ticket numbers are operational facts rather than finance figures, so no approval was needed.
